mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% indicates a tightening labor market, which typically precedes corporate profit growth and positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales signal strong consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the correlation between the joint signal and returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle supply constraints (indicated by rising industrial production growth), S&P 500 forward returns are negative due to inflationary pressures and central bank tightening over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above 3.5% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high labor market tightness (strong payroll growth above 200k jobs per month), S&P 500 forward returns are negative due to rising wage pressures and potential Fed tightening over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0.
